item.description: In some environments you may want to prevent a particular local user from initiating outbound network connections, while still allowing that user to run services that listen on ports and respond to inbound connections. This can be achieved with iptables by blocking only NEW outbound connections from that user, while allowing ESTABLISHED/RELATED traffic to continue.
